## Enhanced Hosting Bundle


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000109488

Forever Free Hosting remains the reliable foundation included with every BD site. The Enhanced Hosting Bundle adds AI SEO visibility, extra bandwidth, and SSL security.

Because AI crawling demands more resources, Enhanced Hosting is designed to safely manage the extra load.

```
Get This Service Visit our website: Enhanced Hosting Bundle
```

Forever Free Hosting AI Bots — BLOCKED To protect shared resources AI Credits — 3 0 PER MONTH Use AI to create content & update your site Server Resources — STANDARD For shared hosting environments Extra 10GB Bandwidth — ADD-ON SSL Security — ADD-ON Enhanced Hosting Bundle AI Bots — ALLOWED OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Apple, DDG AI Credits — 80 PER MONTH The standard 30 plus 50 extra every month Server Resources — DOUBLE For enhanced hosting environments Extra 10GB Bandwidth — INCLUDED SSL Security — INCLUDED ✅ Best For : New and established sites with steady traffic ✅ Best For : AI SEO visibility without a dedicated server

Note : AI bots are blocked on Forever Free Hosting to protect shared resources due to the aggressive nature of AI crawlers. The Enhanced Hosting Bundle enables AI-friendly crawling while adding resources to keep your site fast.
